name: cone-of-frost-level3-decline-first-target-still-offers-second
notes: Cone of Frost at level 3: the level-1 'up to one target' is declined, then the level-3 one is used on the opposing champion. The decline used to skip ConeOfFrostStep, so the level-3 offer never appeared.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Cone of Frost's optional-choice continuation (ConeOfFrostStep) was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the prompt (PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods skip the handler and its follow-up never ran: the later level clauses were never offered after a declined target. Fix: the queue site passes dontSkipOnPass and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
